subject: physiology
title: Male reproductive physiology

steps.tx: The **testis** makes sperm in seminiferous tubules nursed by Sertoli cells secreting inhibin and anti Mullerian hormone, testosterone from Leydig cells under luteinising hormone, spermatogenesis over seventy four days by meiosis behind a blood testis barrier, Sertoli stimulation by follicle stimulating hormone suppressed by inhibin, and puberty started by gonadotropin releasing hormone pulses. Descent completes inguinally around birth, undescended testes need orchiopexy near year one, torsion twists a bell clapper emergency, and left varicocele bags worms warming counts. Tubules therefore nurse sperm daily.
steps.say: Sperm are made in seminiferous tubules over about seventy four days, nursed by Sertoli cells that also secrete inhibin, while Leydig cells between tubules make testosterone under luteinising hormone, the dual axis drawn in the figure. Follicle stimulating hormone supports Sertoli function and inhibin feeds back selectively. Undescended testes need early orchiopexy, torsion is a surgical emergency, and a left varicocele warms the scrotum and lowers counts.

vis.alt: Male hypothalamic pituitary gonadal axis: GnRH drives LH and FSH; LH stimulates Leydig cells to make testosterone, FSH acts on Sertoli cells to support spermatogenesis and inhibin B; testosterone feeds back on the hypothalamus and pituitary and inhibin B on FSH.
vis.caption: LH to Leydig to testosterone; FSH to Sertoli to sperm and inhibin B.

steps.tx: **Testosterone** comes from cholesterol in Leydig cells, converts to dihydrotestosterone in prostate and hair by five alpha reductase, anabolises muscle and deepens beards, climbs haematocrit by erythropoiesis, drives libido in brain, and splits hypogonadism by low or high luteinising and follicle stimulating hormones into primary or secondary. Klinefelter XXY talls with gynaecomastia, Kallmann anosmia lacks gonadotropin releasing hormone, adrenal dehydroepiandrosterone brings adrenarche, finasteride blocks five alpha conversion, and anabolic abuse atrophies testes. Hormones therefore masculinise or fail visibly.
steps.say: Leydig cells build testosterone from cholesterol, target tissues convert it to the stronger dihydrotestosterone for prostate and hair, and the hormone builds muscle, red cells and libido, summarised in the actions table. Low testosterone with high gonadotropins means testicular failure as in Klinefelter syndrome, low with low means central failure as in Kallmann syndrome with lost smell. Finasteride blocks conversion, and abused anabolics shrink the testes they imitate.

vis.alt: Table of testosterone sources and actions: made by Leydig cells from cholesterol under LH, converted to DHT in the prostate and skin by 5-alpha reductase, causing male external genitalia, prostate growth and hair, with anabolic effects on muscle and bone, erythropoiesis and libido.
vis.caption: Testosterone builds muscle and red cells; DHT makes the external genitalia, prostate and hair; hypogonadism reverses these.

steps.tx: **Erection** fills by parasympathetic nitric oxide cyclic GMP, prolonged by phosphodiesterase five sildenafil forbidden with nitrates, emits by sympathetic vas deferens contraction, fails by diabetic neuropathy, dies by high prolactin libido loss, preserves nocturnally when psychogenic, and leaks by Doppler arterial or venous failure. The prostate ages into screening debates by prostate specific antigen, benign hyperplasia by terazosin and finasteride, and biopsy sepsis cautions, while sickle priapism aspirates ischaemically. Nerves therefore fill before blood traps.
steps.say: Erection is parasympathetic: nitric oxide raises cyclic GMP and fills the corpora, ejaculation is sympathetic, the point and shoot contrast in the neural diagram. Sildenafil prolongs the signal but must never meet nitrates, diabetes damages the nerves, and high prolactin kills desire while night erections persist in psychogenic cases. Ischaemic priapism in sickle disease needs urgent aspiration, and prostate enlargement answers to alpha blockers or finasteride.

vis.alt: Neural control of erection and ejaculation: parasympathetic S2 to S4 nerves release nitric oxide raising cGMP and relaxing corporal smooth muscle for erection; PDE5 inhibitors prolong cGMP; sympathetic T11 to L2 drives emission and somatic pudendal fibres drive ejaculation.
vis.caption: Parasympathetic: point (erection). Sympathetic: shoot (emission). PDE5 inhibitors need nitric oxide, so nitrates are forbidden.

steps.tx: **Semen analysis** reads volume near one point five millilitres by World Health Organization limits, count fifteen million per millilitre, motility forty percent, and morphology by strict Kruger criteria, with azoospermia split obstructive against Y microdeletion, varicocele repair improving, and intracytoplasmic injection using single sperm. Infections atrophy by mumps orchitis, block by sexually transmitted epididymitis, dip for three months after fever, clump by antisperm antibodies after vasectomy reversal, and fall by heat and smoking lifestyle. Samples therefore analyse production and delivery together.
steps.say: A semen sample reports volume, concentration near fifteen million per millilitre, motility near forty percent and strict normal forms, the reference limits tabled in the image. No sperm means blockage with normal hormones or production failure with high follicle stimulating hormone and small testes, varicocele repair can help, and single sperm injection bypasses severe deficits. Mumps, infections, fever, heat and smoking each depress the count for months.

vis.alt: Table of normal semen parameters from World Health Organization lower reference limits: volume 1.5 mL, concentration 15 million per mL, total motility 40 percent, progressive motility 32 percent, normal forms 4 percent by strict criteria.
vis.caption: Azoospermia means no sperm: obstructive (normal FSH, normal testes) or non-obstructive (high FSH, small testes).
